description: Header file defining utilities, macros, classes, and functions for NCCL (NVIDIA Collective Communications Library) integration within PyTorch's distributed module, including version-dependent feature macros, error checking, NCCL communicator wrapper, and error handling.

classes.name: NCCLComm
classes.description: Wrapper class for NCCL communicator, managing its lifecycle, error states, and device info.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an NCCL communicator with specified parameters.

methods.name: waitReady
methods.description: Blocks until the NCCL communicator is ready.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the NCCL communicator with optional failure reason.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Flushes operations and prepares the communicator for shutdown.
